Restaumatic: KDS 'partial' because the comparison table includes it in PRO+ and PRO+AI only, not PRO. No amounts visible on its price list, so the plan has price_major null; the country quote is from its Polish-language price list (the site is Polish-language at /pl/). GoPOS: the 'Food truck' card is about an on-screen order-number system, not order-ahead for trucks, so focus is nearest_local. ahead is 'partial' (online takeaway orders, but choosing a pickup hour isn't stated).
